description: This file is a makefile fragment for building the Linux kernel within the OpenWrt build system. It includes dependencies, defines build steps, download procedures, and cleaning routines specific to kernel compilation.

methods.name: Kernel/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the kernel build environment using default settings.

methods.name: Kernel/Configure
methods.description: Configures the kernel build using default configuration.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileModules
methods.description: Compiles kernel modules using default settings.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage
methods.description: Builds the kernel image and initramfs.

methods.name: Download/kernel
methods.description: Defines download parameters for the kernel source.

methods.name: Download/git-kernel
methods.description: Defines download parameters for the kernel source from a git repository.

methods.name: Kernel/CollectDebug
methods.description: Collects debug symbols and kernel image for debugging purposes.
